integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the finite convex Gram representation, an explicit kernel/range argument, and the connected-set refinement of Caratheodory's theorem. The rank and real-dimension calculations were checked symbolically; no finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The atom-count bounds are upper bounds; no minimality or sharpness assertion is made.
The statement is for finite Bessel families and does not turn the countable representation theorem into a finite-support representation.
An older equivalent rank-sensitive compression under matrix-convexity, cubature, or bounded-correlation terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Rank-sensitive finite probability models for Bessel Gram matrices
